task: Give a --chunk run's stderr enough information to tell a dead agent from a clean one, and one chunk from another.
approved_by: user ("approved", 2026-09-12, in direct response to the fold-in proposal in the prior message)
notes: Two compounding gaps found while investigating a PMB peer's field report, both in the real-time stderr progress channel (never in the JSON/report output, which is unaffected). (1) AgentProgressEvent has no status field; a dead agent (fetch failed, timeout) and a clean one both render as 'Ns -- 0 raw findings', distinguishable only by duration, which nothing parses. The status IS already computed at every emission site (agentStatus[agent.name] = classifyAgentError(err)) in the same statement block as the onProgress call that omits it -- purely additive, zero existing test asserts the exact line text. (2) chunkRunner.ts's per-chunk loop prints no marker between chunks, and runner.ts's run() resets index=0 on every call -- chunkRunner calls run() once per chunk with the same onProgress callback -- so '[1/4] security' prints with the IDENTICAL index on every chunk. A multi-chunk run's stderr gives no way to tell which chunk you're reading without counting resets. This is why the reporting peer had to hand-build a chunk-by-chunk table themselves. Not part of #84 (agentPolicy/filteredFiles/chunk-merge) -- unrelated concern, new branch off main rather than bundled into that PR's diff.
